name: Service Lookup
description: Search and inspect Windows services by name or display name.

params.name: InfoNote
params.default: Search and inspect Windows services by name or display name.

params.name: Query
params.label: Search Query
params.description: Enter service name or display name. Supports partial matches and wildcards (*).

params.name: UsageInfo
params.default:
How to Use:
- Enter service name (e.g., 'wuauserv') or display name (e.g., 'Windows Update')
- Search is case-insensitive and supports partial matches
- Use wildcards (*) for broader searches

Examples:
  'windows update' - Find Windows Update service
  'print*' - Find all print-related services
  'audio' - Find audio services
  'remote' - Find Remote Desktop services
